arms.ungated_s05: kind prior strength=0.5, zero_signal_gate=False, frozen teacher snapshot (cache_ttl=1e9)
arms.gated_s05: kind prior strength=0.5, zero_signal_gate=True, frozen teacher snapshot (cache_ttl=1e9)

protocol.primary_metric: byte-identity of full per-generation history + evals_total + first_success_eval (sha256 digest), gated vs control per (scenario, seed)
protocol.guard_metric: pooled holdout successes within budget, Fisher exact

rules_registered: R1''': PRIMARY claim = transparency, success iff gated==control byte-identical on ALL pairs
R2''': any gated-vs-control divergence is a falsifier: dump, investigate, no success claim
R3''': guard: gated-vs-control Fisher must show no detectable difference (identity implies it)
R4''': ungated-vs-control is descriptive (v2 replication + perturbation quantification)
R5''': defaults unchanged by any outcome: the prior stays opt-in/off
R6''': teachers/budget/metrics byte-comparable with v2/M7/M8 harnesses

ungated_divergence.reading: the RNG-stream perturbation the M6 gate removes
